title: kiesera minor
intro: Kiesera minor, commonly known as Gotu Kola, is a type of plant that belongs to the Centella family. The leaves of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to their numerous health benefits, including improving cognitive function, enhancing skin health, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gotu Kola include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to treat conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Gotu Kola include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
